subject: phy-u-fund
title: (R)PHY.U.FUND.------POL.DYM.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-36 — the section on multi-national corporations and the structural permeation of multi-national power-politics through western political functionalism. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'no political decision of consequence can be viewed as separate from the composite area of controlling factors related to what a multi-national company really is. Because among other things, politics is about power — and economics.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of physical-universe-fundamental structurally meets political-dynamics at the multi-national scale: (R)PHY-U-FUND (the reality of physical universe fundamental) crossed with POL-DYM (political dynamics). PHY-U-FUND sits on the left with the subject-arrow; POL-DYM sits at top-center as partner-axis; PART (participation) branches from the main line to the upper-right. SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation) drops from PART at lower-left, and AFI (affinity insight) drops from PART at the bottom-center, with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and PRI-INFO (principle information) branching from AFI and PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics) from PRI-INFO.
